rules.text:
Savage Attacker
Origin Feat
You’ve trained to deal particularly damaging
strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with
a weapon, you can roll the weapon’s damage dice
twice and use either roll against the target.

authored_operations.trigger: Once per turn when weapon hits target
effects: Roll weapon damage dice twice and choose either whole roll; preserve other damage riders, constants and critical weapon dice; not reroll individual low dice
authored_operations.ending_and_identity: Exact acquired feat instance owns parameters, budgets and grants; once-only acquisition and per-turn receipts; no replay on restore.
